profile.headline: Software Engineer at Rocket Money
profile.summary:
Senior backend developer with a love for agile, modular design. Transferred my creativity from the visual arts to programming. I am focused first and foremost on serverless development in AWS using Python and Java as my primary languages. I have worked with both relational (MySQL) and NoSQL (DynamoDB) databases. I also have some experience building front-end applications with tools including React and Angular and Python. Fluent in French and English, I enjoy leveraging my diverse skill set to whatever provides businesses value.

Languages: Python, Java, SQL, Terraform, TypeScript, JavaScript
Frameworks: React, Dropwizard, Angular, Flask, Ruby on Rails
Platforms: AWS (Lambda, S3, API Gateway, Cognito, IAM, EventBridge, Kinesis, SNS/SQS, etc.)
Databases: MySQL, DynamoDB
Misc: Terraform, DBT, REST Architecture, Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), Auth0, Segment, Optimizely

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
❍ Served as technical lead for the consumer growth team, which owns disparate subsystems including partner-facing APIs, promotions and referral programs, communications and user segmentation.
❍ Launched partners including Microsoft and Uber on Upside's Partner API
❍ Centralized a number of redundant communication pipelines around a data funnel (Segment) and a new REST service, reducing app load time by 400ms, reducing maintenance overhead and improving the SDLC around e-mails and notifications.
❍ Re-architected our partner system to be config-driven, allowing an operations team to begin launching new third party API integrations without code changes.
❍ Saved Upside 300K annually by optimizing Python and Java code and the company’s usage of AWS products including Lambda and DynamoDB.
❍ Built reverse ETL pipelines using Dagster and DBT to funnel analytical data from Snowflake back into Upside’s backend for use in billing and fee calculation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
❍  As a member of a tiger team, authored vital contributions to a major engineering initiative to launch a fourth product vertical (convenience stores)
❍  Wrote components and services for client-facing user interfaces with Angular in Typescript, including a new page to act as the source of truth for merchant accounting.
❍  Expanded a message-oriented backend architecture centered around Java microservices
❍  Built and deployed Lambda functions written in Python through serverless
❍  Co-authored a new form of cultural interview for engineers
❍  Established and lead a weekly session to teach junior engineers and data analysts Python
❍  Leveraged Cytoscape.js to build a graphic visualization of our serverless architecture in React

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a full stack engineer at a family media company, I worked full stack on both customer-facing and in-house software.

React frontend, communicating through Apollo, AppSync and GraphQL with a DynamoDB database. 

I utilized a wide array of technologies on the job including:
❍ Data visualization in Amcharts4
❍ Arduino and AppleScript for process automation
❍ Python for AWS Lambda functions. 
❍ Various AWS services including Cognito, IAM, APIGateway, CodePipeline/CodeBuild and more.

positions.title: Bootcamp Student
positions.description:
As a student in this 15 week immersive, in-person bootcamp, I learned front-end development with JavaScript and React and back-end development with Ruby on Rails. My projects at Flatiron School included:

1997 Chat
A realtime, 90s themed chat application
❍  Utilized websockets and ActionCable to provide real-time instant messaging 
❍  Wrote custom CSS to simulate a Windows 95 desktop in React
❍  Securely stored user information in Ruby on Rails with bcrypt

MetroRider
A metro fare and trip time calculator
❍  Implemented a Rails API to pull user preferences from a PostgreSQL database
❍  Wrote an adapter to fetch real-time train information from WMATA’s API
❍  Created responsive forms using jQuery and vanilla Javascript
❍  Utilized both Bootstrap and custom CSS to style modals

Black Lotus
A Magic: The Gathering Deck Builder and card viewer  
❍  Developed a Rails API backend with endpoints for users, cards and decks
❍  Implemented user interface with React and styling with react-semantic
❍  Utilized JWT (JSON web tokens) to store encrypted user information client-side
❍  Made use of Chart.js to provide users with deck analytics.

positions.title: Lead Sales Associate
positions.description: Supervision and training of sales associates, stock ordering, file and record keeping, customer service.

positions.title: Artist Assistant
positions.description: Worked closely with acclaimed multimedia artist Luca Buvoli on diverse projects including pre-fabrication installation design and the production of animated works for an exhibition at the Museum of Contemporary Art in Cleveland. Also assisted with 3D modeling in Photoshop for a large-scale public installation in Seattle, Washington.

volunteerExperiences.description: As a volunteer, taught English to an intermediate-level, mixed-background class, lead a conversation class and tutored students on an individual basis.
